blocks.heading: Twilightscapes
blocks.subheading: Unique night photography by Todd Lambert — abandoned places and dark skies across the American backroads. Now an ambient photo app for Apple TV, iPhone & iPad.

blocks.body: Twilightscapes is a decades-long project photographing the world after dark — ghost towns, lonely churches, desert geology, and the Milky Way over places most people drive past in daylight. Every photo here was made at night, on location, with long exposures and a lot of patience.
